subject: #527 review repairs pushed to PR #541 and ai-kit #443: oi act transport fixed, save-and-start completes the journey, TUI lifecycle bound to the production backend, act doorway unified
result: Repairs from the owner review of the command-encounter convergence, executed on branch convergence/command-encounter-20260926 in both repos (worktrees command-encounter-finish-20260927). O-I commit bb2b1a58: (1) oi act invoke accepts --json and forwards it; the >64KiB stdin path now appends the native - input argument and passthrough args, with parity tests asserting the exact payload the owner receives (Central parsed the missing - as {} and silently lost the input); early owner exit reports its own status, not a broken pipe. (2) bare oi act lists the read-only Action field as its usage always claimed. (3) cradle saveAndStart returns the prepared session and all three Save-and-start buttons chain choose(prepared) — the compound journey now ends in the opened conversation (unit + browser tests prove it with no manual relay); per-stage operations moved into a collapsed Stage-by-stage section; human stage labels with stable data attributes; fixed the stale skillsets read-exemption that made the published browser suite red. ai-kit commit 93906bd4: (4) V2SurfaceService implements all six Agent-work lifecycle methods over real owner operations (Central agent-profile express/review/accept CAS, folded direct-agent-session prepare, encounter owner daemon launch) plus forwards the Factory pair — previously every stage silently ran the refusing trait default; agent_work_bindings answers from the actual Central scope; wiring-proof tests added. (5) act doorway reads the SAME resource field the TUI renders (ApplicationService::navigation_index_from made pub), act invoke dispatches contextual Actions to their real owners (Factory start-work via the surface adapter; read Actions name aikit explain/history; surface-internal Actions name aikit ui) — a capability run never substitutes for an Action; act describe carries real input contracts; aikit search now surfaces contextual Actions with subjects/owner/routes. Suites: ai-kit aikit-cli+aikit-tui green except the PR-documented pre-existing environmental gitnexus failure; O-I cli green, clippy -D warnings clean both; desktop unit 16/16 + browser 7 checks pass; tsc clean. Remaining (named, per the review): A3 executable praxis support; TUI SkillSet picker and composed-World oi ui handoff; the deeper purpose-to-repertoire-to-review compaction of the creator form; O-I #541 base/ancestry reconciliation (1190 changed files incl. site/Quartz work); fresh-agent and installed-cut V1 tests through the actual entry points. Worktrees preserved pending review (PRs open, not landed).
